response.overview: Driven by a childhood dream of becoming a film director, Javid grows up only to find himself trapped in the commercial side of the industry, completely detached from art. Bored and seeking self-discovery, he accidentally travels to the future and meets his older self. Realizing the future world is in ruins, Javid attempts to return to his own time only to disrupt the cosmic timeline and crash into an entirely different era.
